The HWPX generation failed because the required severity string 'High (즉시조치)' was missing from the XML section files.
The verifier failed with an AssertionError in test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present within /tests/test_outputs.py. Specifically, the assertion `assert f'{value} ({severity_map[value]})' in combined` failed because 'High (즉시조치)' was not found in the concatenated content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While the summary JSON files were likely generated correctly, the HWPX XML structure did not reflect the expected summary values.
